answer: Random presence windows force a farm to stay staffed. Each epoch opens unpredictable ten-minute windows; an identity must sign a heartbeat in each, and weight scales with how decorrelated its wake times are from its cluster. A dune records every wind that passed; so does this. Agents that always wake together share one pattern and price as one. A prism splits one beam into many colours but makes no light: heads woken by one cron job stay one head. What costs is staggered presence: N schedulers, each losing standing per missed window. A carved onyx can be copied; layered sediment cannot.
